sentences.en: Your job will be to liaise with our clients.
sentences.zh: 你的工作就是与我们的客户保持联系。

sentences.en: It's your job to serve as a liaison between them, so you'd better liaise.
sentences.zh: 你得充当他们之间的联络人，所以最好多沟通一下。

sentences.en: The marketing team will liaise with the suppliers.
sentences.zh: 营销团队将与供应商联络。
